issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: stone_brick_wall, iron_bars, red_wall_banner.
Only 164 blocks: too bare for a landmark (at least 200). Carlton wants more detail, not less.
stone_bricks is 55 % of the build: break it up with a second material.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.detail: Adds iron bars in the corner notches, red banners front and back, a hanging lantern under the arch and lanterns on wall posts; still sparse for a gate.
notes.roof: Same flat spruce caps as L1.
notes.depth: Front faces are flat apart from the arch corbels.

visual.summary: L1 plus iron-bar windows, red banners over the arch and on the back of the towers, and lanterns; the corner notches are now filled.
problems: Tower caps are still flat spruce stair pairs at y8 with exposed stair ends: give the towers a proper top.
Towers barely rise above the walk merlons; a landmark gate should stand taller.
Big flat stone-brick faces on the towers (sides x0 and x6, z3 back): add a plinth, string course or buttress for depth.
Reachability: walk at y5 has no stair in this piece; reached from a neighbouring wall_tower - fine for a module.
